journeys.title: Baseline, public access and identity
journeys.purpose: Record the deployed source SHA, prove public discovery and sign-in/out work and that administration surfaces are not exposed. Run first; later cases cite the SHA it records.

journeys.title: Pickup + cash on receipt: Customer → Kitchen → Operations/Finance/Admin
journeys.purpose: The core order journey: basket and quote, placement, the kitchen accepts/prepares/readies, pickup handover with the customer's code, then operations, finance and the administrator inspect the same synthetic order.

journeys.title: Delivery + cash on receipt
journeys.purpose: Same journey with delivery to Test zone A: fee in the quote, courier hand-off, failure/complete paths, cash due and its verification.

journeys.title: Pickup + 50% direct deposit
journeys.purpose: Manual deposit to the approved (fake) recipient: customer reports transfer, kitchen reports receipt (gate before preparation), remainder in cash, reconciliation.

journeys.title: Delivery + 50% direct deposit, zero platform charges
journeys.purpose: Deposit with delivery and a courier; no commission, service fee or tax anywhere.

journeys.title: Guards on the journey: prices, repeats, isolation
journeys.purpose: Server-owned price after a change, immutable placed prices, duplicate submit, a guest basket through sign-in, and isolation between customers and kitchens.

journeys.title: Kitchen workspace and operations control
journeys.purpose: Cook publishes a meal and opens a slot; cross-kitchen access is refused; staff see only what they are granted; a customer cannot make themselves staff; kitchen approval and permission grants (these two need the updated deployment and staff MFA).

journeys.title: Two-step verification (after the updated deployment and the owner-approved realm migration)
journeys.purpose: Optional MFA end to end on the web: enrol, step up, policy authorization, staff high-risk actions. Policies stay OPTIONAL.

journeys.title: Physical devices
journeys.purpose: Account switch and step-up on a real iPhone/Android build.
